description: Combined CPI (2024 base) split into goods and services: weight (%), index (weighted average of MoSPI item indices with MoSPI item weights), y/y and contribution (pp) to CPI y/y, monthly from Jan 2025 (y/y from Jan 2026). Items typed by COICOP 2018 (MoSPI's ND/SD/D/S marks in Annex 5.3d). Asia Decoded calculation; built by the AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals pipeline (data/in/cpi_core/in_cpi_goods_services.csv).
schedule: Replaced after each release by a scheduled task that reads AsiaDecoded/asia-vitals.
title: India goods and services CPI
